label: Plato, Theaetetus 171e-172a: What the… supports Some content is ABSOLUTELY_TRUE_1
note: Conceded by the restricted Protagorean (Theaetetus 171e-172a), on the narrow reading only: outside the relative domain it is not the case that seeming makes true for the one to whom it seems, and opinions there differ toward truth. Evidence, not inference: neither a particular case nor the bridge to absolute truth is attributed or assumed.
